# Marksly

> Marksly is an all-in-one school and campus management platform for academies, schools, colleges and universities in Pakistan — attendance, fee collection and online payments, exams and results, timetable, ID cards, and WhatsApp/SMS parent messaging in one system.

Marksly is built specifically for how Pakistani institutions run day to day: local payment rails (JazzCash, EasyPaisa, bank transfer) for fee collection, WhatsApp/SMS for parent communication, and a free plan for up to 50 students with no card required to start.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://marksly.pk/): Overview of the platform and core features.
- [Features](https://marksly.pk/features): Detailed breakdown of attendance, exams & results, timetable, fees & invoices, student records, parent messaging, ID cards, and reporting.
- [Pricing](https://marksly.pk/pricing): Plans, limits, and frequently asked pricing questions.
